title: survive the night
description:
Survive the Night

Survive the Night. is a thrilling horror-themed Minecraft modpack designed for players who love high-stakes survival, atmospheric exploration, and intense tactical defense. If you think vanilla Minecraft nights are too easy, prepare
body: This Minecraft modpack blends horror and realism perfectly. It features tactical firearms from Vic's Point Blank, terrifying entities and Delmos, and an eerie atmosphere powered by Complementary Shaders and Spooklementary. Enhanced by Fresh Animations and Better Leaves, it delivers the ultimate immersive survival experience.
